LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: PII-free public arcade high-score entry for Chudling Pong (supports both verified Google accounts and unique guest IDs).

uid.description: Owner UID (Firebase Auth UID for signed-in users, or guest_<alnum> for guest players).

playerName.description: Public display nickname shown on the leaderboard.

score.description: Best single-run score achieved by the player.

totalScore.description: Cumulative total score across all runs achieved by the player (primary leaderboard ranking).

fireMode.description: Weapon mode used during the best run.

zappedCount.description: Total mosquitoes zapped during the best run.

bestCombo.description: Highest hit streak achieved during the best run.

isGuest.description: True for guest entries using a unique local guest ID, false for Google-authenticated entries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the score was recorded.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Public top-score leaderboard keyed by owner UID or unique guest ID (entryId == uid).
